card.name: Middle of 'aspartate' and similar names
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a split word, mostly 'part' in 'aspartate' (aspartate aminotransferase, AST). It also fires on a few other word-middle pieces like 'art', 'tech' and 'ament' in names.

modes.label: aspartate
modes.description: The 'part' piece after 'as' in aspartate aminotransferase or transaminase.

modes.label: Other split names
modes.description: Middle pieces of split author, publisher or coined words.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of the word aspartate when it is spelled out in liver enzyme lists.
